notes.title: Project notes
notes.description: Dynamic properties. Delete asks, because the fallback is always.

lines.title: Order lines
lines.description: An array table. Row delete asks.

quietLines.title: Scratch lines
quietLines.description: The same table with confirmation turned off for delete.

milestones.title: Project milestones
milestones.description: Nested items, so the expandable array layout renders. Item delete asks.

coordinators.title: Coordinators
coordinators.description: A list with detail. Removing the selected entry asks.

charges.title: Charges
charges.description: An AG Grid. Select several rows and remove them: one prompt covers the batch.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: A mixed value holding nested structures. Type changes use complex; tree Delete uses always.

scalar.title: Reference
scalar.description: Also mixed, but holding a simple value: complex does not ask.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: A oneOf. Changing branch asks; so does clearing it.
